decisions.text: behaviour: with fallback, a model already known to be out of its daily quota is skipped at the start; the request starts on the first usable model instead of answering model_exhausted, because the front desk has no user to choose — reverse: drop the `knownReset && fallback` branch in callGemini

behaviour: /suggest always answers `reason` on a 502 ('other' when the result has no group), so the existing 400 case now expects { error: 'AI_FAILED', reason: 'other' } — reverse: send reason only when the group is not 'other'

behaviour: assistantFailed is removed by a wrapper around runTurn whenever a turn in mode `turn` returns ok, a blocked turn that hands off included — reverse: unset it only on the frontdesk.turn.done paths

behaviour: the front desk switches to the next free model on overload; this is a narrow exception to the 2026-10-09 rule that the server never switches models by itself. It applies only to callers that pass fallback and only among free catalog models on the shared key — reverse: drop fallback: true in server/routes/ai/frontdesk.js
behaviour: the map shows read-only until a time is chosen; the owner's table pick still needs a time first — reverse: drop !this.time_() from onMapTap
behaviour: on the bare dashboard, sign-out happens at once; /dashboard?tab=metadata still asks about unsaved changes — reverse: remove the _isOnBareDashboard() condition in logout()
behaviour: the staff note hides as soon as anyone writes in the chat after the failure — reverse: change showAssistantFailure()
